newsitem.title: USA: Chancellor in pact for 15 Builders Square stores.
newsitem.headline: Chancellor in pact for 15 Builders Square stores.

text.p: Chancellor Corp said Tuesday it has signed contracts valued at $150 million to purchase and lease back to Kmart Corp 15 free-standing Builders Square stores.
Kmart will sign a lease-back agreement for a period of 25 years on each store at the close of escrow, Chancellor said in a statement.
Builders Square operates 168 home improvement stores and is owned by Troy, Mich.-based retailer Kmart.
Chancellor also said it will retain all properties and leases for the entire period, with an annual yield of 10.5 percent.
Chancellor buys investment grade commercial real estate projects.
Kmart officials were not immediately available to comment on the contracts.
